title: SVP, Product Management, Core Banking
description:
ABOUT NYMBUS
Nymbus ( is not just a leader in fintech; we are a community of innovators passionate about reimagining banking. Our modern core platform and cloud based technology serve as the backbone for financial institutions eager to modernize and excel.
Nymbus is building the next generation of fintech platforms, and Domain SVPs are among the most consequential leadership roles in delivering that vision. This role owns the Core Banking domain: the foundational system layer that processes every financial transaction, maintains every account balance, and enforces every posting rule across the platform.
WORK ENVIRONMENT
We are a remote-first company, with occasional travel required for team collaboration or client engagement.
POSITION SUMMARY:
The SVP, Product Management, Core Banking role is the senior product leader responsible for the strategic direction, squad output, and commercial outcomes of the Core Banking domain at Nymbus .

You lead multiple squads that build and evolve the core banking engine - deposits, lending, account structures, posting models, settlement, interest accrual, and the fundamental ledger infrastructure that every other domain depends on. You manage Builders directly, collaborate daily with Architects and Shippers assigned to your domain, and are accountable for everything your domain ships.
This is not a traditional product management role. You operate with four capabilities simultaneously: strategic product leadership, people leadership of Builders, domain subject matter expertise, and AI-first execution. You are expected to be a hands-on SME in core banking systems - someone who has designed, built, or deeply operated core banking platforms and can guide your teams through the complexity of core banking, from operations, finance, teller, to products, entitlements, GL and reconciliations.

You should be equally comfortable discussing market strategy with an executive team, walking through an application funnel with a client, diagnosing friction in an onboarding workflow, and working with product and engineering teams to determine what needs to change.

THE OPERATING MODEL You operate within Nymbus ' AI-native solution operating model:

•
SVP, Product Management, Core Banking (This Role): Owns the domain's strategic direction, manages Builders, drives commercial outcomes, and ensures squad output meets quality and velocity standards. You are the most senior product voice in your domain.

•
Builders (Your Direct Reports): Own product intent, specification, and implementation within each squad. You hire, develop, and performance-manage Builders. You set their priorities, remove their blockers, and ensure they operate at the AI-first standard Nymbus requires.

•
Architects (Collaboration Partners): Report through the Architecture organization but collaborate with you daily. They own system design, technical integrity, and cross-squad consistency within your domain. You coordinate with them on data models, posting engines, and platform integrity.

•
Shippers (Collaboration Partners): Report through the Product Operations organization but collaborate with you daily. They own delivery quality, release management, and operational readiness. You coordinate with them on acceptance criteria, deployment cadence, and production stability.

YOUR DOMAIN: CORE BANKING

• Deposits: Core deposit product engine - account structures, sub-ledgers, posting models (memo posting, hard posting, reversals, adjustments), interest accrual, fee calculation, tiering, minimum balances, and product configuration.

• Lending: Loan servicing lifecycle - consumer, commercial, real estate, construction, and lines of credit. Payment application logic, accrual and capitalization, payoff calculations, late fees, escrow, suspense handl

How should a platform team decide what to build when 50 teams depend on you and each one thinks their request is the most urgent? Today a collector can win a card in a live show, rip a pack, buy on the marketplace, and store it all in a vault - but those moments still feel like separate products. You'll be working in a landscape of multiple existing products with real users and real data, so migration, backward compatibility, and careful rollout are part of the craft.

Responsibilities

- Build scalable, performant, highly available services and interfaces on AWS and Vercel.
- Own features end to end: data model, API contract, front-end implementation, tests, rollout, and post-launch metrics.
- Build and maintain reusable front-end components, APIs, and shared libraries that multiple apps (web and mobile) depend on - and treat other engineers as first-class consumers of what you build.

title: Forensic Utility Bill Auditor

In this role, you will review and analyze utility accounts-including gas, electric, and water-to identify billing errors, incorrect rate classifications, tariff misapplications, unusual usage patterns, and potential overcharges.

You will work with utility bills, customer portals, spreadsheets, AI-powered data extraction tools, and public property information to investigate anomalies and help build evidence supporting potential audit findings and recovery claims.

This position is remote and offers you the flexibility of working from home.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Review customer utility accounts and billing histories to identify high-value accounts requiring further investigation.

• Prioritize accounts based on billing thresholds and potential financial impact.

• Standardize utility statements into clean, readable PDFs suitable for data extraction and analysis.

• Use AI-powered tools to extract up to 24 months of utility billing data into structured spreadsheets.

• Analyze billing information using Month-over-Month (MoM) and Year-over-Year (YoY) comparisons.

• Review key data points, including:

• Billing cycle dates

• Total monthly charges

• Energy or utility consumption

We are looking for a Liquidity & Funding Lead. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the organisation’s liquidity position to ensure optimal funding availability, efficient cash utilisation, and compliance with regulatory and internal requirements. This role involves monitoring daily liquidity, forecasting cash flow, optimising working capital, managing bank relationships, and supporting treasury projects related to liquidity management and risk mitigation.
Responsibilities:

Liquidity Management

• Lead daily monitoring of the group’s cash and liquidity position across entities and currencies.

• Oversee preparation of cash flow forecasts (short-, medium-, and long-term) and ensure accuracy.

• Develop and maintain liquidity risk metrics, limits, and stress-testing scenarios.

• Implement and monitor liquidity contingency funding plans.
Funding Strategy & Capital Planning

• Design and execute funding strategies to support business growth and capital needs.

• Manage credit facilities, intercompany loans, and external funding arrangements.

• Evaluate cost of capital and recommend optimal funding mix.

• Support balance sheet and capital structure planning in collaboration with Finance and Risk.
Risk & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with internal treasury policies, governance frameworks, and regulatory liquidity requirements (e.g., Basel III LCR/NSFR, where applicable).

• Identify liquidity and funding risks and escalate timely to senior management.

• Provide support for audits, reviews, and regulatory submissions.
Reporting & Systems

• Deliver liquidity and funding reports, KPIs, and dashboards to senior management.

• Provide analysis and insights for Board and ALCO (Asset-Liability Committee) reporting.

• Enhance treasury systems and automation for cash and liquidity management.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field.

• 3-5 years’ experience in treasury, liquidity, or cash management roles (banking, payments, or fintech/crypto sector an advantage).

• Strong knowledge of liquidity risk metrics, cash forecasting, and banking operations.

• Solid analytical and problem-solving skills; attention to detail.

title: SDR - Porto
description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

SDR

Serás o primeiro ponto de contacto entre a Teya e potenciais comerciantes. O teu papel será identificar e qualificar potenciais clientes, iniciar conversas relevantes e transformar a prospeção em oportunidades comerciais reais para a nossa equipa de Field Sales.

Sobre a função

O SDR está na linha da frente da operação comercial, os leads chegam até ti já identificados, tratados e classificados, permitindo-te concentrar o teu tempo no que realmente importa: criar boas conversas, compreender necessidades e identificar oportunidades com potencial.

Trabalhas uma lista de leads prioritizada e realizas o primeiro contacto sobretudo por telefone, complementando a abordagem através de email e redes sociais. O teu papel passa por perceber rapidamente se existe fit entre o potencial cliente e a solução, avaliar o seu nível de interesse e identificar se está preparado para avançar para uma conversa comercial.

A tua responsabilidade acompanha todo o processo até à reunião agendada. O fecho da venda fica a cargo do vendedor, mas continuas a ser co-responsável pelas oportunidades que geraste e passaste à equipa. O teu trabalho não termina quando a reunião é marcada: acompanhas a qualidade das oportunidades que crias, assegurando que cada lead qualificado está devidamente associado ao teu contributo e ao impacto que geraste no processo comercial.

O que vais fazer

- Trabalhar uma fila prioritizada de leads classificados com base no perfil e na intenção, fazendo o primeiro contacto principalmente por telefone e utilizando email e redes sociais como complemento.

- Qualificar cada lead com base num conjunto claro de critérios: este negócio tem o perfil adequado e este é o momento certo para conversar?

- Agendar os comerciantes qualificados diretamente na agenda de um vendedor de Field Sales, com pelo menos 48 horas de antecedência, e garantir a realização da reunião através de uma confirmação e de um lembrete no dia anterior.

- Sinalizar leads que demonstram potencial mas precisam de ser contactados num momento mais adequado.

- Encerrar os leads que não têm o perfil adequado, registando um motivo claro e honesto.

- Manter o CRM organizado: registos precisos, notas claras e estados atualizados. A pessoa seguinte no processo depende da informação que registas.

O que vais trazer

- Conforto ao telefone e capacidade para ter uma conversa próxima e útil com um proprietário de um negócio que não estava à espera da tua chamada.

- Capacidade para ouvir mais do que apresentar, percebendo a diferença entre uma oportunidade real e um simples “talvez”.

- Organização e consistência: trabalhas a lista, fazes o follow-up dentro dos prazos e manténs os teus registos atualizados.

- Capacidade para lidar com um “não” com naturalidade e manter uma energia constante ao longo de um dia completo de chamadas.

- Facilidade na utilização de um CRM e de ferramentas modernas de vendas, ou capacidade para aprender rapidamente novas ferramentas.

- Fluência em português.

Será valorizad

title: Demand Planning and Inventory Optimization Manager
description:
Our client, a dynamic Amazon FBA business with a global presence, is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Demand Planning and Inventory Optimization Manager to join its Supply Chain Department. This role will lead efforts in forecasting demand, managing inventory levels, and optimizing stock for their entire catalog of products. As a key part of the Supply Chain team, this individual will ensure that the company maintains optimal stock levels while balancing cost efficiencies and operational requirements.
About the company:
The company is specialised on developing and upscaling Amazon-based brands across the USA, Canada, Europe, and the UK. With deep expertise in eCommerce and Amazon FBA, the company excels in buying, developing, and scaling brands to their fullest potential. The company navigates the complexities of international markets and high-performance marketing, ensuring seamless scalability and growth.
The company's portfolio includes several Amazon brands, primarily in the home and kitchen category, as well as some electronics. Its international team of 17 world-class talents manages all operations today.
Key Responsibilities:

• Demand Planning: Analyze historical sales data, current product trends, and market insights to accurately forecast demand for all products.

• Inventory Management: Calculate and manage optimal inventory levels to ensure product availability while minimizing excess stock and associated costs.

• Order Management: Generate purchase orders for replenishment based on forecasted demand and stock levels, collaborating with suppliers to ensure timely deliveries.

• Stock Control & Optimization: Monitor and optimize stock levels across the catalog, ensuring products are always available in the required quantities and minimizing overstock.

• Analytics & Reporting: Provide regular reports on demand forecasts, stock status, and key performance indicators (KPIs). Use advanced analytics to recommend inventory adjustments and supply chain improvements.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with brand managers, supply chain teams, and other stakeholders to align demand forecasts with marketing, promotions, and sales strategies.

• Amazon Marketplace Management: Oversee inventory management for Amazon, ensuring accurate stock levels, fulfillment coordination, and alignment with marketplace demand trends.

Qualifications:

• Proven experience in demand planning, inventory management, and supply chain operations, preferably in e-commerce.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and generate actionable insights.

• Experience managing inventory for the Amazon Marketplace, including knowledge of FBA (Fulfilled by Amazon) and related processes.

• High attention to detail and organizational skills.

• Experience working with international suppliers, especially from China, is a plus.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Proficiency in Google Spreadsheets, data analysis tools, and demand planning software

• Experience with Inventory Planner would be a plus

• This role is essential for maintaining efficient and cost-effective inventory management while supporting the companys growth through data-driven insights and precise demand forecasting.

What We Offer:

• Fully remote and full-time role.

• Paid time off.

• Yearly bonuses.

• Professional growth opportunities, such as managing staff members and growing your skill set.

• Competitive and timely salary.

• Opportunity to work remotely in an international company.

• Dynamic, creative work environments.

• Flexible schedule.

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 5 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

conversation.

• 3+ years of experience in client onboarding, implementation, or project management within SaaS, professional services, or a related field. You know how to manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects to a deadline.

title: Field Access Manager - Diabetes - New Jersey/Hudson Valley
description:
The Field Access Manager (FAM) will act as the main point of contact at designated accounts providing account management support to Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) and their staff on behalf of patients who are prescribed a product for approved indications. As a part of this strategy, the FAM will provide on-going education to accounts regarding the Patient Services program, the regional payer landscape, and pharmacy channel access. The FAM will help coordinate pull-through efforts for patients who have been prescribed the product, irrespective of channel (HUB, specialty pharmacy, etc.), provided proper HIPAA consent has been secured from the patient. The FAM will be expected to be the primary face of the Patient Services platforms within designated HCP offices. The FAM is also responsible for partnering with internal and external stakeholders to optimize access to the product for patients .
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Expand advocacy within HCP offices and equip the staff, through education, to navigate the access and payer approval process, identify access barriers that the HCP must act on to overcome, and highlight HCP actions that support patient access to therapy.

• Offer educational resources to support the entire patient’s journey by optimizing processes for prior authorizations/appeals/specialty pharmacy and addressing access issues.

• Coordinate utilization of the patient service platform to seamlessly support the customer and patient when office chooses the HUB or SP as their ideal path to approved therapy.

• Coordinate annual pharmacy reauthorizations at designated accounts to ensure timely reauthorization and continuation of therapy is maintained.

• Work cross functionally and collaboratively with partners in Sales, Market Access, Patient Services, Strategic Accounts and more to act as a process and payer expert. The FAM will help identify and address time sensitive market development and implementation efforts to remove access barriers to the product for appropriate patients, while optimizing adherence.

• Build and execute a strategic business plan to meet the needs of top accounts and ensure successful implementation of market access initiatives.

• Obtain and maintain knowledge and understanding of payer landscape, including specialty pharmacy and utilization management criteria, on a national, regional and local level so that you can act as a process and payer expert.

• Continuously strive to understand the alignment of Payer/PBM/SP and how national/regional pharmacy drug formularies impact market access in their designated geography.

• Assist in providing appropriate field insights to ensure support of all access and patient/payer support programs and resources offered by the company’s Patient Support Programs.

• Anticipate, navigate and address individual account and patient access issues that arise by partnering with all appropriate stakeholders.

• Demonstrate a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias.

• All other duties as assigned.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:
The requirements below represent the experience, education, knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for this role.

• Bachelor’s degree required; Healthcare degree advantageous, including MS, RN, PA, PharmD, or similar advanced healthcare/scientific degree.

• 10+ years in pharmaceutical industry with experience in payer policy and patient access.

• 5+ years of experience in benefit verifications and/or prior-authorization requirements or equivalent experience in patient access.

• Knowledge of Centers of Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) policies and processes with experience in Medicare Parts B & D.

• Knowledge and understanding of specialty markets, HUB/reimbursement services and patient access programs.

• Strong understanding of specialty product access/reimbursement processes including Patient Support Service

The ideal candidate is a strategic, results-driven event professional who takes full ownership of event programs end-to-end - from stakeholder alignment and content development through vendor management and on-site delivery. - Drive event project plans and documentation, maintaining accountability for timelines, milestones, and status reporting across multiple concurrent events

- Manage vendor and cross-functional team relationships, overseeing deliverables, contracts, budgets, and proactively mitigating risks and resolving issues

- Lead on-site event execution, directing teams across registration, room management, speaker coordination, and real-time problem-solving

- Own post-event analysis and reporting, synthesizing data, feedback, and performance metrics to inform leadership decisions and drive continuous improvement

Requirements:

- 3 - 5 years of relevant experience in marketing operations, event coordination, or a related discipline

- Strong project management, time management, organizational, and execution skills with keen attention to detail

- Ability to work under pressure and prioritize effectively across multiple concurrent projects while consistently meeting deadlines

- Ability to interact with all levels of internal staff and external contacts with professionalism

Chez Deliveroo, vous ferez un travail qui compte, en résolvant des problèmes concrets dans une marketplace tripartite en constante évolution. Job Title: Senior Jury Consultant
Description:
Perform all tasks associated with jury related litigation consulting. Such as: mock trials/focus group moderation, online jury research, shadow juries, jury selection, community attitude surveys, witness prep, voir dire, demographic profiling, reporting and other related litigation consulting services.
Senior Jury Consultants should have 5+ experience in the field, with capacity to lead focus group research, manage client communication and organize and lead a focus group team.
Client Facing Skills and Leadership
Excellent communication, presentation, and writing skills. Work collaboratively with research team and clients. Work hand in hand with sales team to close deals for jury consulting related projects. Take ownership of projects from intake to delivery.
Jury Consultant Skills
Jury consultants have an understanding of reliable research methods and possess a keen insight into human behavior, motivation, and decision-making heuristics. Excellent interpersonal and communications skills, as well as exceptional writing, speaking and presentation skills, are essential. Performing research and confident consulting, such as making strategic recommendations to clients, are integral skills for the role. Candidates should have exceptional abilities in qualitative and quantitative analysis and bring the full scope of their professional experience as primary tools of the trade. Knowledge of social science research methodology is key.
Pretrial Duties
Management of jury research including intake calls, client communication and focus group coordination, and leading focus group team on site. Mock trials/focus group moderation, online jury research, community attitude surveys, witness prep, voir dire, demographic profiling, reporting, etc.
Trial Duties
Shadow juries, jury selection, juror social media/public records research, trial monitoring, strategic consulting, visual communication consulting, etc.
Educational and experience
Graduate degree (Ph.D. and/or Master’s) in psychology or related field (i.e., neuroscience, communication, etc.) and/or J.D. is preferred. Applicants interested in a senior-level consultant position should have a minimum of 5 years’ experience in the field.
Although a law degree isn't required, a jury consultant should at least possess a firm understanding of the civil legal process, procedures, and terminology. Client development skills are also helpful.
Technical Skills
Microsoft Office Suite, Analytical software (such as SPSS), general understanding of presentation technology.

(Compensation packages include a base salary plus monthly incentive-based pay based on actual work performed.)

title: Mechanical Engineering Intern
description:
About Graphcore

Graphcore is a global leader in artificial intelligence computing systems. We design advanced semiconductors and data center hardware that deliver the specialized processing power needed to advance AI while improving the efficiency required for broad adoption.

As part of SoftBank Group, Graphcore belongs to a family of companies developing some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Our new AI Engineering Campus in Austin will play a central role in building the future of AI computing.

The Opportunity

As a Mechanical Engineering Intern, you will contribute to the mechanical design and thermal validation of advanced AI hardware. Working alongside experienced mechanical and thermal engineers, you will gain hands-on experience with 3D computer-aided design (CAD), laboratory setup, test development, prototype evaluation, and engineering documentation.

What You’ll Do

• Contribute to mechanical design activities using Creo or comparable 3D CAD software, including part modeling, assemblies, drawings, and design updates under the guidance of experienced engineers.

• Work with the thermal engineering team to develop test procedures and help set up laboratory capabilities for evaluating AI hardware.

• Support thermal and mechanical testing using appropriate laboratory equipment; collect, organize, and analyze test data.

• Assist the mechanical and thermal design teams with prototype evaluation, troubleshooting, design verification, and documentation of findings.

• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering partners, communicate progress and issues clearly, and follow applicable laboratory and safety procedures.

What You’ll Bring

• Current enrollment in a bachelor's, master's, or doctoral program in mechanical engineering or a related discipline during the internship. Students in other disciplines with relevant mechanical engineering experience will also be considered.

• Foundational knowledge of mechanical design, heat transfer, thermodynamics, materials, manufacturing, or related engineering principles gained through coursework or practical experience.

• Ability to approach technical problems analytically, document work accurately, communicate clearly, and collaborate effectively.

• Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn unfamiliar tools, systems, and laboratory methods.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with 3D CAD software; Creo experience is helpful but not required.

• Hands-on laboratory experience, including setting up equipment, conducting tests, recording observations, and reporting data.

• Interest in thermal management, electronics cooling, servers, data center hardware, or advanced computing systems.

In this role you will be engaging the global partner ecosystem that accelerates the adoption of our AI Materials platform, which is critical for delivering next-generation semiconductor and advanced materials to market.
